import os
import shutil
import time

CHAT_LOG_PATH = "logs/general_chat.log"
CHAT_ARCHIVE_DIR = "logs/archive"
MAX_LOG_BYTES = 1_000_000


@tool
def general_chat(message: str) -> str:
    response = str(llm.invoke(message))
    # Rotate the chat log: move it to the archive folder once it grows too large
    if os.path.exists(CHAT_LOG_PATH) and os.path.getsize(CHAT_LOG_PATH) > MAX_LOG_BYTES:
        os.makedirs(CHAT_ARCHIVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        archived_name = f"general_chat_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.log"
        shutil.move(CHAT_LOG_PATH, os.path.join(CHAT_ARCHIVE_DIR, archived_name))
    return response
